component.name: Tegami
component.summary: Calm mail that sorts itself and works offline

description.p: Tegami opens on the few letters that need you today, in the order to read them. The rest sorts itself into Important, Purchases, Updates and Newsletters.

ul.li: Your mail is kept on the computer. Read and answer offline; replies send themselves when you are back.
Pictures from the internet and trackers stay out of your letters.
With Claude Code on the computer, ask about your mail and get drafts. Nothing is ever sent without you.
Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, Seznam and any IMAP mailbox. Passwords stay in the keyring.

screenshot.caption: Today: the letters that need you
